Build prompt

Design a weather-ghost app icon. 1024px squircle (iOS continuous-corner mask). Base: vertical gradient #38BDF8 -> #2563EB. Atmosphere: 3-4 soft cloud wisps (white, blur 40, 25-45% opacity) drifting at bottom-left and top-right, one wisp crossing the midline; faint radial light from top. Mascot: a round ghost in outline only - 6px stroke in white with a soft blue glow (shadow 0 0 24px #93C5FD), two vertical oval eyes and a small curved smile filled white/blue, wavy three-hump bottom edge; ghost fill = white/85 with inner blue shadow for depth. Center the ghost at 55% of icon height; keep clearspace = 1/6 icon width. Export variants: with and without clouds.
